<script setup lang="ts">
import { onMounted } from 'vue'
import AContainer from "../common/AContainer.vue";
import type { Row } from "../../../../types/EditorTypes";
import RenderHeader from "../../RenderHeader.vue";

// Props passed from page/layout
const props = defineProps<{
  theme: "light" | "dark"
  header: Row[],
  menu : any[],
  languages:{ default_lang: number, code: string }[],
  related_pages:any,
  locale:string
}>()

/** Sticky nav only runs on client */
onMounted(() => {
  const checkSticky = () => {
    const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop
    const nav = document.querySelector(".sticky-nav")
    if (!nav) return

    if (scrollTop > 130) {
      nav.classList.add("on-stuck")
    } else {
      nav.classList.remove("on-stuck")
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener("scroll", checkSticky)
  setTimeout(checkSticky, 50) // initial check after mount
})
</script>

<template>
  <AContainer
      class="sticky-nav navOnStuck"
      :style="{ marginTop: '15px', zIndex: 9999, padding: '10px', borderRadius: '16px' }"
  >
    <RenderHeader :rows="props.header" :theme="props.theme" :menu="menu" :languages="languages" :related_pages="related_pages" :locale="locale" />
  </AContainer>
</template>

<style lang="scss" scoped>
.sticky-nav:not(.on-stuck) .logo_nav {
  display: none;
}

.on-stuck .white_on_stuck {
  color: var(--header-btn-color) !important;
}

.navOnStuck {
  position: sticky;

}

.sticky-nav {
  transition: all 500ms ease-in-out;
  width: 100%;
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 9999;
  border: 1px solid var(--header-border-color-first);
  background-color: var(--header-bg-color-first);
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--header-blur-first));
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--header-blur-first));
}

.on-stuck {
  padding: var(--header-padding);
  border: 1px solid var(--header-border-color);
  border-top: 0;
  border-bottom-left-radius: var(--header-border-radius-bottom);
  border-bottom-right-radius: var(--header-border-radius-bottom);
  border-top-left-radius: 0 !important;
  border-top-right-radius: 0 !important;
  background-color: var(--header-bg-color);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(var(--header-blur)) !important;
  max-width: var(--header-max-width) !important;
  width: 100%;
  backdrop-filter: blur(var(--header-blur)) !important;
}
</style>
